reviews.x: Great stuff at a great price!  Smells so fresh and clean.  Women love it and always ask what I’m wearing.  Only downside is that the smell only lasts about 4-5 hours on your body (but MUCH longer on your clothes)
Very fresh and clean, citrus and mint and ...sandalwood? Very nice daytime and warm weather fragrance

reviews.t: Doesn't last long but smells great
reviews.x: Pro: Smells fresh and pleasant. As good or better than Aqua di gio Con: Doesn't last long enough nor emit/spread the scent out as far as I'd like

I made the mistake of putting this on,  smelling it and assuming it would quickly dissipate to an acceptable level... It did not. The smell is too flowery  , overpowering and left me wishing i tested it before leaving the house...  It was clearly irritating others.  I confessed the smell was coming from me just to relieve the situation.  not really sure what to do with it?  use it to mask the garbage cans?  Give it to a tramp?  One thing is certain,  i won't be using this "fragrance".
Warning! Didn't smell like real penguins! I'm a penguin expert.

I wanted a new fall fragrance to take the place of the summery Issey Miyake for Men, and I couldn't have done better. This Penguin blend is crisp, warm, rich, and makes some amazing and delightful changes the longer it is worn. I've never tried any other Penguin scent, but I'm very happy with this one. Expensive, like any other premium cologne, but if this aspect of grooming is important to you, it is well worth it.
This is by far the best cologne for a man. I get plenty of compliments. Has a light sweet smell, it is somewhat strong don't use more than 2 shoots.
This cologne is a bang! You can't go wrong with the beautiful smell. My wife loves this sooooo much. I'm buying another one shortly.

I read the reviews and bought this product, but it doesn't smell at all; it's just pure alcohol. Also, this item is not eligible for return. Thanks to Amazon for giving me a return on my gift card for this purchase, I really appreciate that. But I want others to know that this product should be taken down, it's not good at all.
A young, clean, beachy scent. I get a lot of compliments when I wear this cologne. Highly recommended as an alternative to Armani Aqua Di Gio if that’s one of your favs.
Smells great, refreshing and subtle. But not an eye drop substitute.

reviews.t: This is my Favorite cologne and this is my eighth  bottle I Purchase
reviews.x: This is my Favorite cologne and this is my eighth bottle I Purchase. I received a lot of compliments when I wear it. You will not be sorry if you buy this cologne.
I love the scent, but more importantly so does my wife. It is a light almost citrusy scent. At least that’s what I think
Sweet citrus with subtle flower notes. Great product for the price.

This cologne is one of the better scents I've found for myself. Originally I bought a bottle at one of the budget stores like Ross or TJ Max, I can't recall. After using that bottle, I went searching and found this one on amazon.  I find that it lasts about as long as Versace Eros on me. The value is excellent on this size/cost cologne. I'm no scent expert so I'm not sure what other information would be helpful, but I definitely recommend trying it!

Was looking for something a bit less pricey than Acqua di Gio and decided to give this a try. Nice light and fresh scent, has notes similar to a "baby powder" scent with fresh spring flower overtones. It has become my daily driver and I plan to purchase more soon.
One of my favorite colognes.  Smells amazing and on here you get an even more amazing deal! You won’t go wrong with this smell.

reviews.t: Perfect. Super fresh. Masculine. Will buy againin.
reviews.x: This product arrive in perfectly condition. Very sun. Smell a like original. Super fresh. Masculine fragance. Too ingles.

reviews.t: ... this cologne at a sale at Dillard's and I love it. I get many complements on this cologne
reviews.x: I got this cologne at a sale at Dillard's and I love it. I get many complements on this cologne. I highly recommend it.
Very mild citrus-oriented fragrance, mild compared to say Mugler Amen. Safe for humidity and heat.
The stuff smells great and last a long time.

Very disappointed in this, I am officially done trusting reviews when it comes to stuff that has any scent or flavor. This is not fresh, it's not good, it smells like any other generic cologne you'd get at the dollar store. The reviews that state it lasts any longer than 30 minutes are either lying or they have a super nose because I sprayed it on and the smell was completely gone within 30 minutes. Plus when I received it I went to try it out and the cap leaked to the point it was almost unusab

Weird but i got this at TJ Maxx for about $12 and then i tried to use it. Everytime i wear this my sister always says SMELLS GREAT. Then i wear it at work and may guy coworker told me that he likes the perfume that i wear compared to the previous one that i used past few months ago. He tried to asks me whats the brand,i told him its PENGUIN bro. And his reaction was WHAT REALLY?IT REALLY SMELLS GREAT BRO.. then another encounter at ROSS when im about to check out the woman in a counter told me i

reviews.t: A re-imagined version of Calvin Klein's CK1?
reviews.x: When I applied this for the first time, my wife immediately asked if I was wearing CK1. However, I had to agree with her that the initial impression was similar to that of CK1. The drydown, however is a little different and more pleasant to me. This is a very generic scent and would just as easily work on a man or a woman. Having about forty colognes in my collection, this does not rank anywhere near my favorites. However, it would work really well for an everyday scent and can hardly be beat fo

This cologne smells so good. I purchased for my husband as one of his birthday gifts. I had not smelled it before he opened it so I was keeping my fingers crossed that it would smell good. It is perfect. It's not overly strong and it has a great wear time. The price point is great. The packaging is cute. I don't have anything bad to say about this fragrance.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the scent as fresh, clean, and citrusy, and many say it draws compliments.
Several reviewers note the fragrance does not last long on the body.
Many reviewers consider it a great value or good product for the price.
A few reviewers find the scent too flowery, overpowering, or not as expected.
